GET /api/alerts.title: Fluid pound - incomplete pump fillage
GET /api/alerts.root_cause: Heated zone has cooled to 170 C, so oil viscosity is 48 cP. Reservoir inflow is 9.5 m3/d but the pump displaces 24.5 m3/d at 3.5 SPM, so the barrel is only 42% full and the plunger hits the fluid on every downstroke (shock loads on rods and pump).
GET /api/alerts.fix: Reduce speed to about 1.7 SPM to restore ~88% fillage, or enable the closed-loop VFD with pump-off control. Economic re-steam point is in 213 days.

GET /api/alerts.title: Steam flashing at pump intake (gas interference)
GET /api/alerts.root_cause: Produced fluid at 170 C is hotter than the saturation temperature (158 C) at the pump intake pressure of 0.59 MPa, so water flashes to steam inside the barrel and the pump gas-locks (CNN card: Gas / steam-flash interference).
GET /api/alerts.fix: Keep more fluid above the pump (about 32 m more submergence) - lower the pump at the next pull or hold a higher fluid level until the zone cools; vent casing gas to the flow line.

alerts.fix: Keep more fluid above the pump (about 140 m more submergence) - lower the pump at the next pull or hold a higher fluid level until the zone cools; vent casing gas to the flow line.
